summary: Hotfix. [Orders (completed)] accidentally also filters Channel = "Online", so the AOV denominator counts only online orders and AOV jumps. The fix is one line. A rollback would remove the Staff exclusion Finance needs for tomorrow's board pack and requires reverting a warehouse schema migration: a big, risky change to fix a small bug. Waiting leaves a visibly wrong KPI in front of managers for two days.
root_cause: [Orders (completed)] filters FactSales[Channel] = "Online" as well as Status = "Completed". The name says completed orders; the code says completed online orders.
steps: Diagnose in DAX query view: compare [Orders] with [Orders (completed)] by channel. All non-online channels show blank.
Hotfix branch from the release tag: remove the Channel filter. One line, one PR, reviewed by a second person.
Test: AOV back to about $210 in Test; regression check of the other release 2.3 KPIs (Staff exclusion unchanged).
Deploy through the pipeline (not by editing Production), then verify in Production.
Tell Jordan and the managers what was wrong, since when and that it's fixed. Add a test: AOV within ±20% of last week, run after every deployment.

options.wait: Leaves a wrong number on the app until Thursday afternoon while managers are already asking. Waiting is right for cosmetic issues, not for a KPI people act on.
options.hotfix: The right call: small, understood, testable change; keeps the rest of release 2.3, including the Finance fix the board pack needs.
options.rollback: Rollback is for when you don't understand the failure or it's widespread. Here it would remove 13 good changes, including one Finance needs tomorrow, and needs a warehouse schema revert first.

review.junior: Rolls back everything because something is wrong.
review.competent: Finds the filter and fixes it in Production directly.
review.senior: Finds the cause, chooses a tested hotfix through the pipeline, protects the rest of the release, communicates and adds a regression test.
review.architect: Defines a hotfix policy (criteria, approvals, path through the pipeline) and requires KPI sanity tests after every deployment.
